test_title: PYST 42 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 5 persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between C and D, considering towards right of D. B is sitting second to the left of D. A is sitting second to the right of C. Who is to the immediate right of D?
solution:
Given:

1. Only one person sits between C and D (towards right of D). Since persons face the centre, right is counter-clockwise. So C sits second to the right (counter-clockwise) of D.

 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• D C 

2. B is second to the left of D. Left is clockwise. So B sits at top-right position.
 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• D B C 

3. A is second to the right of C. Right is counter-clockwise. So A sits at bottom-right. E fills the remaining seat (top-left), which is immediately to the right of D.
 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• D B A C E 

So, **E** sits to the immediate right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
